{{Top|leg}}
A '''director unit''' was a device used by [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]]. It broadcast commands to [[Shock collar/Legends|slaving collars]], directing high-voltage electrical shocks into the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. Some units also featured a kill option.
